 Print 'Immortal' OTT release date OUT. GV Prakash Kumar and Kayadu Lohar 's romantic horror film 'Immortal' is set to arrive on OTT after its theatrical release on September 4, 2026. GV Prakash Kumar plays Magi, a young man employed at his uncle's printing press. His uncle, played by Lollu Sabha Maaran, provides him with work while Magi searches for a suitable place to live in Chennai. His circumstances lead him to Sindhu, portrayed by Kayadu Lohar. She lives in a luxurious apartment and offers Magi a room at an unusually low rent. Looking for affordable accommodation, he accepts her offer without understanding the danger connected to his new living arrangement.  The film will stream on SonyLIV, which shared the digital premiere update via social media with the message, “Oru pudhu ulagam... Oru IMMORTAL kadhal!” (A new world… an immortal love story.) 'Immortal' will begin streaming on October 30, 2026. An ancient mystery lies at the heart of the story
 The narrative opens around 1,000 years ago, when a tribal couple has a child with mysterious supernatural qualities. The birth introduces an ancient evil that becomes important to the events taking place centuries later. The story then shifts to modern-day Chennai, where Magi's housing search brings him into contact with Sindhu. His decision to move into her apartment initially appears to solve his immediate problem. However, the situation takes a frightening turn as he finds himself trapped inside the building, with escape seemingly impossible. Cast and supernatural elements in 'Immortal'
 Along with GV Prakash Kumar and Kayadu Lohar, the film features TM Karthik, Kumar Natarajan and Lollu Sabha Maaran. 'Immortal' received two stars out of five in the ETimes review. The review criticised the film's execution and its reliance on familiar horror conventions. ETimes exclusive review read, "Immortal plays out like a textbook of horror film templates with the blandest execution. In a film like Pizza, we worry about the Vijay Sethupathi character being trapped in a haunted house because of how the character has been presented to us, with relatable traits, issues, and motivations. Here, we hardly care for Magi and only feel that he deserves it as his entire personality can be defined as: a horny young man. "
